import hashlib
data=open('/app/code.png','rb').read()
h0=hashlib.sha256(data).digest()
candidates=[
 "0000TBENCH-SALT",
 "OOOOTBENCH-SALT",
 "000OTBENCH-SALT",
 "OOO0TBENCH-SALT",
 "0000TBENCH-SALT",
 "000OTBENCH-SALT",
]
# also generate all combos of 0/O for first 4 chars
import itertools
for combo in itertools.product("0O", repeat=4):
    s="".join(combo)+"TBENCH-SALT"
    if s not in candidates:
        candidates.append(s)
for s in candidates:
    SALT=s.encode()
    H=hashlib.sha256(h0+h0[:10]+SALT).hexdigest()
    print(f"{s!r} -> {H}")
EOF",

import hashlib

def main():
    SALT = b"0000TBENCH-SALT"
    with open("/app/code.png", "rb") as f:
        img_bytes = f.read()
    h0 = hashlib.sha256(img_bytes).digest()
    # sha256(h0 || h0[:10] || SALT)
    H = hashlib.sha256(h0 + h0[:10] + SALT).digest()
    print(H.hex())
    return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
